events.title: Finally! GGPO-style rollback netcode!
events.summary: Hi! I’m back with a major network update for Rasen! I’ve implemented GGPO style rollback netcode for the online multiplayer. After trying a few different networking models, I realised that none of them were good enough for this type of fast, parry-based melee combat, particularly in terms of responsiveness and behaviour under latency, jitter or packet loss. events.title: Rasen - Announcement
events.summary: Hello everyone, I'm super excited to finally announce you my personal project, which I've been solo working on. I'm a huge Soulsborne fan and Dark Souls III was the spark that pushed me into creating this game and getting into game development in the first place. I really love the precise combat of Sekiro, the dark fantasy atmosphere of Dark Souls, and the fast-paced, competitive style of GunZ.
